messages:
elaine_cs: FYI — FinSearch (enterprise) hit 403 on text generation after their SSO key rotation. Embeddings endpoints succeed. Customer pasted curl + response below.

josh_se: can you paste the exact curl + response body? quick check vs. perms we expect.

elaine_cs: sure — repro from their side: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-alpha-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Response: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`
Body: `{\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\",\"message\":\"request requires: inference.generate\"}`

ellaine_cs: they also try embeddings: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-embed-1\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Embeddings return 200+vector payload.

nico_security: that pattern screams: token carried embeddings/rerank but not inference scope. Could be SCIM/SCIM-provisioner mapping dropped `inference.*` when converting group claims. Any recent deploys to the provisioner?

jake_infra: deploy-bot shows a lambda change 2319990670 touching `provisioner/claim-normalize` yesterday. I see a commit that trims role list to 1 characters if comma parsing fails — likely bug: `roles.split(',')[0]`. If their SCIM had `roles: \"inference,embeddings\"` and the comma had non-standard char it would truncate.

deploy-bot: [deploy] provisioner/claim-normalize v1.4.2 -> v1.5.0 deployed by jake_infra at 2023-11-23T18:37:50Z

josh_se: can we reproduce locally? elaine, any chance the customer can repro with a newly minted svc key so we can compare JWT `scope` claim?

elaine_cs: asked them to create a new key via SSO portal and share the token header (they redacted the key). They returned decoded JWT claims: `{\"sub\":\"svc-finsearch\",\"scope\":\"embeddings rerank\"}` — missing `inference`.

nico_security: yep, provisioning failed to include `inference.generate` scope. Likely mapping rule expects `inference` but we map to `inference.generate` later. Need quick remediation and longer term fix.

sam_customer: this is blocking our search UI — can you provide a short-term workaround? We rotate keys nightly and need stable behavior.

jake_infra: short term: create a manual API key for their org via the admin console with both `inference.generate` and `embeddings.read` scopes. I can create one and tag it `temp/finsearch-ssoroll`.

elaine_cs: created temp key and sent to customer over their secure channel. Customer confirms: `generation OK now, thank you`.

sam_customer: confirmed — generation works with the temp key. Will hold rotation off for 24h.

josh_se: next steps: 1) hotfix provisioner to stop trimming roles, 2) add unit test for non-ASCII comma, 3) backfill affected orgs and re-provision keys or issue admin patch that appends missing scopes when detected. Who owns? jake_infra + nico_security collab.

nico_security: I'll open a security-triage ticket and include repro tokens and decoding steps (sanitized). Also recommend a guard in auth service to reject tokens that have embeddings but not inference when their org has `search` product flag enabled.

jake_infra: opened infra ticket INFRA-5231. assigning to @jake_infra, @nico_security. Patch PR 438 in progress to stop splitting on bare comma only.

elaine_cs: filing customer follow-up: apologized, noted mitigation, timeline for fix ~ 6h for patch + 24h for backfill. Customer asked for audit of last 7 days for any dropped inference perms — will run query.

deploy-bot: [alert] unusual-provisioning-rate spike for scim-provisioner at 2319990500 - 2319991100, ~12 orgs affected.

josh_se: prioritize detection script to list tokens where `scope` claim lacks `inference` but embeddings works (embed calls succeed). Put results in INFRA-5231.

elaine_cs: summarizing for ticket: repro steps, sample curl+403, decoded claims, temp key issued, customer confirmation. Adding logs + deploy diff.

sam_customer: thanks everyone — please keep me posted in thread, our SRE will pause rotation when you say it’s safe. :pray:

elaine_cs: will update. follow-up: patch merged to canary, will monitor for any regressions, then roll to prod.
